title: Pipeline Triage Agent
description:
An LLM-assisted triage tool for Apache Airflow pipeline failures. It reads a failed task's logs, classifies the root cause, and may open a pull request with a suggested fix — but only when the root cause is one a repository change can actually address. A throttled third-party API, a bad upstream feed, or a table dropped outside the codebase cannot be fixed by editing the repository, and a patch that makes such a pipeline pass has hidden the problem rather than solved it.

The archive contains the agent, a dashboard, and a local Airflow harness that reproduces fifteen realistic pipeline failures with genuine tracebacks, six of them written after the agent's prompt was frozen. It also contains the full data behind the reported results: 1,350 diagnoses across three models and three versions of the agent (the original prompt, specific root-cause guidance, and a structural root-cause field with a server-side gate), patch verifications in which every pull request offered for an unfixable failure was applied and its pipeline re-run, and the captured failure evidence each diagnosis was given.
